docs.subject: prov_allenai
docs.text: Ai2, founded by Paul Allen and led by Ali Farhadi, conducts high-impact research and engineering to tackle key problems in artificial intelligence.

docs.subject: prov_allenai
docs.text: Non-profit AI research institute releasing open-weight models (OLMo, Molmo, Tulu), open datasets, evaluation frameworks and research tools, plus a free playground

docs.subject: prov_alibaba
docs.text: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio is a one-stop model service platform; call models on demand with no infrastructure to manage.

docs.subject: prov_alibaba
docs.text: Cloud model-as-a-service platform: hosted inference APIs for the Qwen model family (Qwen-Max, Qwen-Plus, Qwen-Flash) plus third-party LLMs (DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM), covering text generation, image and video understanding/generation, speech recognition and synthesis, and embeddings; OpenAI-compatible API, online playground, pay-as-you-go billing.

docs.subject: prov_amazon
docs.text: "Amazon's mission is to make customers' lives better and easier every day by relentlessly inventing on their behalf."

docs.subject: prov_amazon
docs.text: Online shopping, cloud computing, streaming entertainment, consumer electronics devices, advertising, healthcare and AI services; AWS AI services include Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker AI, AgentCore, Amazon Q, Amazon Connect, Kiro, and Trainium chips.

docs.subject: prov_anthropic
docs.text: "An AI safety and research company working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems."

docs.subject: prov_anthropic
docs.text: Claude AI assistant (web, desktop, Claude Code, Cowork, Design, Science, Security, Chrome, Microsoft 365) and the Claude Platform API for developers.

docs.subject: prov_azure
docs.text: "Microsoft Foundry is a unified platform to build, ground, and govern AI apps and agents that understand your business context."

docs.subject: prov_azure
docs.text: Cloud AI platform: Foundry Models (11,000+ foundation, open, reasoning, multimodal models), Foundry Agent Service, prebuilt tools (OCR, translation, speech, vision), Foundry IQ, Control Plane governance and observability, Foundry Local for edge.

docs.subject: prov_baidu
docs.text: An enterprise-grade, all-in-one large model platform centered on Agent development.

docs.subject: prov_baidu
docs.text: Model-as-a-service and agent development platform: unified API access to ERNIE models and open-source foundation models (DeepSeek, MiniMax, Kimi, GLM), model inference services, agent building tools, data intelligence services, and multi-language SDKs.

docs.subject: prov_bedrock
docs.text: "Amazon Bedrock: The platform for building generative AI applications and agents at production scale"

docs.subject: prov_bedrock
docs.text: Managed access to hundreds of foundation models, agent build/deploy (AgentCore, Managed Agents), knowledge bases and fine-tuning, Guardrails safety, model distillation, prompt caching and routing.

docs.subject: prov_bfl
docs.text: The frontier AI research lab for visual intelligence — "What hasn't been can now be."

docs.subject: prov_bfl
docs.text: FLUX generative visual models (image and multimodal) via a hosted API and dashboard, open-weight models for self-hosting, a browser playground, and enterprise deployments

docs.subject: prov_bland
docs.text: Enterprise Voice AI Platform for Phone Agents.

docs.subject: prov_bland
docs.text: AI phone-call agents (inbound and outbound voice), plus SMS/iMessage/web-chat channels, IVR replacement, call transcription and call intelligence, on their own voice infrastructure

docs.subject: prov_bytedance
docs.text: The ByteDance Seed team, established 2023, is dedicated to discovering new approaches to general intelligence, pushing the boundaries of AI.

docs.subject: prov_bytedance
docs.text: AI research lab and model group inside ByteDance; research areas include LLMs, speech, vision, world models, infrastructure, AI Infra, and next-generation AI interactions. Operates labs in China, Singapore, the United States and other locations. Models are served commercially through Volcano Engine Ark.

docs.subject: prov_cartesia
docs.text: AI that learns and interacts like humans.

docs.subject: prov_cartesia
docs.text: Voice AI models and platform: Sonic text-to-speech, Ink speech-to-text, and Line for building voice agents; research on state space models (Mamba, H-Nets)

docs.subject: prov_cohere
docs.text: "Own your AI" — foundational AI models and enterprise solutions with secure private and on-prem deployment.

docs.subject: prov_cohere
docs.text: Foundation models (Command generative, Embed, Rerank, Transcribe) via API, plus enterprise products (North workplace agent platform, Compass search) and private/VPC/on-premise deployments.

docs.subject: prov_databricks
docs.text: The data and AI company — the leading Data and AI Platform for enterprises.

docs.subject: prov_databricks
docs.text: Enterprise data + AI cloud platform (lakehouse): data engineering and warehousing, Unity Catalog governance, BI, Lakebase serverless Postgres, Genie assistant, and Agent Bricks / Mosaic AI for building AI agents and applications

docs.subject: prov_deepgram
docs.text: "Voice AI built for real conversations" — a research-driven foundational AI company for voice technology.

docs.subject: prov_deepgram
docs.text: Voice AI APIs: speech-to-text (batch and streaming), text-to-speech, a Voice Agent API, and Audio Intelligence analysis; cloud plus on-premise/self-hosted deployment.

docs.subject: prov_deepseek
docs.text: "探索未至之境" ("Explore uncharted territories"); API described as compatible with OpenAI/Anthropic formats.

docs.subject: prov_deepseek
docs.text: Own frontier LLMs served via a chat app, mobile app, and an OpenAI-compatible inference API with tool calls, context caching, and files.

docs.subject: prov_elevenlabs
docs.text: "Bringing technology to life" — AI research and products that transform how we interact with technology.

docs.subject: prov_elevenlabs
docs.text: AI audio and voice: text-to-speech, speech-to-text, voice cloning and design, dubbing, sound effects and music generation, and conversational voice agents, all available as APIs.

docs.subject: prov_exa
docs.text: "The world's data for AI agents" — an applied AI lab building a perfect search engine.

docs.subject: prov_exa
docs.text: Web search and data APIs for AI agents: Search API, Contents API, Agent API, Monitors API, and Exa Connect, backed by their own web index/vector database.

docs.subject: prov_intercom_fin
docs.text: An advanced AI Agent that provides fast, accurate answers to customers 24/7 via live chat, email, SMS, WhatsApp, social and more.

docs.subject: prov_intercom_fin
docs.text: AI customer-service agent (support, sales and ecommerce) across chat, email, voice and social; in-house Apex models; Fin Operator for back-office actions; Copilot for human agents; API, integrations and MCP

docs.subject: prov_fireworks
docs.text: "Own Your Specialized Intelligence" — "Own your model. Own your future."

docs.subject: prov_fireworks
docs.text: Inference hosting (serverless, on-demand, reserved), model fine-tuning and training infrastructure, a hosted model library, and Fireworks Nexus routing for AI coding.

docs.subject: prov_google
docs.text: "AI for every developer" — "Unlock AI models to build innovative apps and transform development workflows with tools across platforms."

docs.subject: prov_google
docs.text: Gemini Developer API (text and multimodal models), Imagen image generation, Veo video generation, Gemma open models, Google AI Edge on-device deployment, and coding assistance tools.

docs.subject: prov_groq
docs.text: "Groq is the premier neocloud for fast inference" — "Fast LLM inference, OpenAI-compatible. Simple to integrate, easy to scale."

docs.subject: prov_groq
docs.text: AI inference cloud (GroqCloud) on bare-metal LPU/LPX infrastructure; OpenAI-compatible LLM inference API with enterprise governance and controls.

docs.subject: prov_ibm
docs.text: watsonx.ai: a next generation enterprise studio for AI builders to train, validate, tune and deploy AI models.

docs.subject: prov_ibm
docs.text: Enterprise AI and cloud platform: watsonx studio for building/tuning/deploying models, Granite open models, data and governance tooling, consulting

docs.subject: prov_ideogram
docs.text: A free-to-use AI tool that turns your ideas into stunning images, in a matter of seconds.

docs.subject: prov_ideogram
docs.text: AI image generation and editing — web app, iOS app, developer API and MCP server; models Ideogram 3.0/4.0 with strong text/typography rendering, editing, remix, background removal and custom brand models

docs.subject: prov_meta
docs.text: Meta AI products, models and research; "Your next build starts with Muse."

docs.subject: prov_meta
docs.text: Foundation models and developer access: Muse Spark (coding-optimized multimodal model), Muse Glimmer (30B open model for local agent workflows), Llama 3 and Llama 4 open models, the Meta Model API for self-serve API access, and Muse Code, a terminal-based coding agent. Open weights distributed via GitHub and Hugging Face.

docs.subject: prov_microsoft
docs.text: "Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more."

docs.subject: prov_microsoft
docs.text: Cloud computing (Azure), productivity software (Microsoft 365), AI (Copilot), gaming (Xbox), and developer tools.

docs.subject: prov_minimax
docs.text: Building AGI with our mission Intelligence with Everyone; global leader in multi-modal models and AI-native products.

docs.subject: prov_minimax
docs.text: Multimodal foundation models and AI-native products sold via API and subscription: MiniMax M3/M2.7/M2.5 language models, H3 video generation, Speech 2.8 speech synthesis, Music 3.0 music generation, plus MiniMax Code (coding agent platform), MiniMax Design, and the Audio and Talkie consumer voice apps.

docs.subject: prov_mistral
docs.text: "Frontier AI. In your hands." — "We help organizations build tailored AI systems to solve the world's hardest problems."

docs.subject: prov_mistral
docs.text: Frontier LLMs plus an API/console (Studio), agents (Vibe, Vibe for Code), custom model training and evaluation (Forge), and AI Cloud training/inference infrastructure.

docs.subject: prov_moonshot
docs.text: "Seeking the optimal conversion from energy to intelligence" — "Kimi LLM Open Platform: Build with Kimi API."

docs.subject: prov_moonshot
docs.text: Own Kimi LLMs, the Kimi assistant/agent products, and a developer API platform with playground, agents, and coding tools.

docs.subject: prov_nous
docs.text: Nous Research is a leader in the American open source AI movement, training world-class open source language models.

docs.subject: prov_nous
docs.text: Open-source LLMs (Hermes family), Nous Portal with one account for Hermes Agent, an Inference API and Hermes Cloud, plus Nous Chat and distributed-training infrastructure

docs.subject: prov_nvidia
docs.text: Experience the leading models to build enterprise generative AI apps now.

docs.subject: prov_nvidia
docs.text: NIM inference microservices and hosted model APIs: performance-optimized, portable containerized microservices with industry-standard APIs for deploying AI models across cloud, data center and local workstations, covering large language, retrieval, visual, multimodal, healthcare, route-optimization and climate-simulation models. NVIDIA also describes itself as having pioneered accelerated computing, engineering chips, systems and software.

docs.subject: prov_openai
docs.text: "Docs and resources to help you build with, for, and on OpenAI." — OpenAI Developers

docs.subject: prov_openai
docs.text: APIs and models for building custom AI experiences, plus Codex (a coding agent) and plugins that extend ChatGPT and Codex; consumer ChatGPT.

docs.subject: prov_openrouter
docs.text: "The Unified Interface For Every Model" — a unified API to access all the major LLM models on the market.

docs.subject: prov_openrouter
docs.text: Model routing / unified inference API aggregating 500+ AI models from 80+ providers (text, image, video, audio), with uptime optimization and custom data policies.

docs.subject: prov_perplexity
docs.text: "Power your products with unparalleled real-time, web-wide research and Q&A capabilities."

docs.subject: prov_perplexity
docs.text: AI answer engine plus a developer API platform: Search API, Agent API (web-grounded answers with citations), Sonar API, Embeddings API, and a model Router.

docs.subject: prov_reka
docs.text: Reka AI builds natively multimodal models (Spark, Edge, Flash, Core) for video, image, audio, and text, used by enterprises in security, media, and defense.

docs.subject: prov_reka
docs.text: Multimodal foundation models and inference API (Reka Chat, Reka Vision for video understanding, Reka Clip for AI video editing), plus training-data and inference infrastructure

docs.subject: prov_serper
docs.text: "The World's Fastest & Cheapest Google Search API" — results in 1-2 seconds.

docs.subject: prov_serper
docs.text: Google SERP search API: web, images, news, maps, places, videos, shopping, scholar, patents and autocomplete endpoints returning structured JSON.

docs.subject: prov_stability
docs.text: The enterprise-ready partner for teams and creators, delivering professional-grade generative AI products.

docs.subject: prov_stability
docs.text: Generative media models and services: Stable Image, Stable Video, Stable Audio, Stable 3D, a Brand Studio creative platform, a developer Platform API, and self-hosted licences

docs.subject: prov_stepfun
docs.text: Founded April 2023 with the mission of "intelligence leaps, multiplying everyone's possibilities"; develops self-built Step foundation models including Step-1 and multimodal Step-1V.

docs.subject: prov_stepfun
docs.text: Chinese foundation-model developer: Step family of text, multimodal, image and audio models served through the Step API open platform, plus a consumer assistant app

docs.subject: prov_tavily
docs.text: "Connect your AI agents to the web" — one secure API for real-time web access.

docs.subject: prov_tavily
docs.text: Web access API for AI agents: Search, Extract (LLM-ready content), Crawl, Map (URL discovery), and a Research agent; also an MCP server.

docs.subject: prov_tencent
docs.text: Tencent Hunyuan is a family of general-purpose and multimodal large models developed fully in-house by Tencent, covering text, image, video, speech and 3D.

docs.subject: prov_tencent
docs.text: Cloud-hosted large model APIs: text generation, multimodal understanding, image generation, video generation, 3D model generation, ASR speech recognition, machine translation, and role-playing models, delivered through Tencent Cloud with a console, quick-start guides and API documentation.

docs.subject: prov_thinking-machines
docs.text: Building a future where everyone has access to the knowledge and tools to make AI work for their unique needs and goals.

docs.subject: prov_thinking-machines
docs.text: Frontier AI research and models: Inkling open-weights models and Tinker, a platform/API for fine-tuning and developing with models; research publications and open-source work

docs.subject: prov_together
docs.text: "Build what's next on the AI Native Cloud. Full-stack AI platform for inference, fine-tuning, and GPU clusters — powered by cutting-edge research."

docs.subject: prov_together
docs.text: AI cloud platform: serverless and batch inference, dedicated model and container inference, provisioned throughput, fine-tuning, GPU clusters, sandboxes, managed storage.

docs.subject: prov_upstage
docs.text: We build intelligence for the future of work.

docs.subject: prov_upstage
docs.text: LLMs (Solar Pro 4, Solar Mini, Syn Pro) via API and cloud deployment, Document AI (Document Parse, Information Extract), and Upstage Studio for building AI agents

docs.subject: prov_vapi
docs.text: "Speak human to every customer" — build and deploy voice agents at customer scale.

docs.subject: prov_vapi
docs.text: Voice AI agent platform: API-first orchestration of STT, LLM and TTS providers, telephony/SIP integration, real-time monitoring, and enterprise controls.

docs.subject: prov_vertex
docs.text: "Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI) is a comprehensive platform for developers to build, scale, govern and optimize agents."

docs.subject: prov_vertex
docs.text: Cloud AI platform for building, scaling, governing and optimizing AI agents and models on Google Cloud.

docs.subject: prov_writer
docs.text: WRITER is the enterprise AI agent platform trusted by Fortune 500 companies, built to help teams execute and scale on-brand, compliant work.

docs.subject: prov_writer
docs.text: Enterprise generative AI platform: AI agents for business workflows, in-house Palmyra LLMs, developer API and app-building tools

docs.subject: prov_xai
docs.text: Intelligent, fast, and cost-effective models across code, text, voice, image, and video.

docs.subject: prov_xai
docs.text: Grok model APIs: Code API for agentic coding, Responses API for text generation, chat, function calling and structured outputs, Voice API for text-to-speech and transcription, and Imagine APIs for image and video generation and editing.

docs.subject: prov_zhipu
docs.text: "Powering the Future with Z.ai" — "Advanced AI Chatbot & Agent powered by GLM."

docs.subject: prov_zhipu
docs.text: Own GLM-family models (LLM, multimodal, image, video) sold as API token bundles, plus a chat/agent product and a GLM Coding Plan subscription.
